todaysTask.title: State Management with Context API
todaysTask.description: Build a theme toggler (Light/Dark mode) using React Context. Make sure the user preference is saved in localStorage.

pastSubmissions.title: API Fetching & Error Handling
pastSubmissions.instructions: Fetch data from a public API, handle loading and error states gracefully, and display the results in a clean, responsive UI.

pastSubmissions.title: Responsive Flexbox Gallery
pastSubmissions.instructions: Build a responsive image gallery using Flexbox. It should look great on a 390px mobile screen and scale up on larger viewports.
